_comment: Authoritative prompt-size ceilings read by scripts/check-token-budget.sh (fail-CLOSED in CI). .agents = agent .md + every frontmatter-preloaded SKILL.md; .skills = every *.md under loomwright/skills/<dir>/, recursive; .commands = loomwright/commands/<stem>.md. Weight = bytes / proxy_bytes_per_token, an OFFLINE PROXY, not an Anthropic token count. The gate enforces budget; measured is the snapshot the mirror tables in ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACTS.md §'Prompt Token Budgets' must equal; note is one line.
proxy_label: proxy tokens (bytes/4 — offline proxy, not an exact Anthropic count)
raise_rule: Raise a ceiling in the SAME PR that breaches it: edit budget here and its mirror row in the same edit, and set note to a ONE-line reason (under 200 chars). History goes to CHANGELOG.md (agents: also the ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACTS.md raise log), never into note. A new skill dir or command doc starts at measured + ~10%.
